Bring [[Cembrien]] the [[Kree Minotaur Hide|hide]] of a [[Kree Minotaur]] to convince him to change your secondary [[profession]] to [[Elementalist]].
{{TOCright}}

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
* Not being [[Profession|primary or secondary]] [[Elementalist]].
* Did not complete [[Augury Rock]] for the first time as a secondary Elementalist.

===Objectives===
* Go to [[Prophet's Path]] and slay the [[Kree Minotaur|kree minotaur]].
* Take the [[Kree Minotaur Hide|kree minotaur hide]] to [[Cembrien]] in [[Heroes' Audience]].

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 200 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* Elementalist available as a secondary profession.

==Walkthrough==
If you are a ranged character of some sort, this quest is easy. Go west from [[Augury Rock (outpost)|Augury Rock]] to the [[teleporter]] near the Kree Minotaur. If you attack the Kree Minotaur from the raised area, it will not be able to reach you, although it will frequently run out of range for a short time. Melee characters will have to make a small detour to the north to get to the lower area that the Kree Minotaur patrols, or use the teleporter to cross the valley and take a shorter detour south. Be sure to pick up the [[Kree Minotaur Hide]] before you [[map travel]] back to Heroes' Audience to get the reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Cembrien
:''"Others may be devoted to a single god, but the Elementalist seeks knowledge from any source. This is why we hold power over all the elements. Knowledge, you see, is power.''

:''The desert holds many secrets for those who would uncover them. Are you such a seeker of knowledge? Then let your journey begin in '''Prophet's Path'''. Long ago, those lands were ruled by the Sorcerer [[Lord Kree]], who controlled an army of beasts, their flesh inscribed with runes of power that only he understood. Even today, among the progeny of his ancient army are sometimes born those bearing the mark of Kree. Bring me the hide of one such '''kree minotaur''' and your quest for knowledge will truly begin."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I will do what I must.
| decline = I'm smart enough as is.
| ask = You will most likely find a '''kree minotaur''' in '''Prophet's Path'''. Kill the beast and bring me its hide.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Cembrien
:''"Yes, this is it! The pattern is faint and incomplete, but someday...someday I shall gather the whole pattern and unlock the secrets of the Sorcerer lords of old.

:''Do you understand now? Power can be gained only through the pursuit of knowledge. If you are beginning to understand this in the least, perhaps you have a chance to become an Elementalist."''

== Notes ==
*This is the only secondary profession quest to require delivering an item instead of just killing a boss.
{{anomaly|The [[Quest Log]] will update when the Kree Minotaur is killed, instead of when the hide is picked up like in most item delivery quests. Cembrien will not accept a Kree Minotaur Hide that is acquired without killing the Kree Minotaur, but the hide is required to complete the quest.}}
